## Summary

BoardUI (boardui.com) — a React design system positioned explicitly against generic AI-generated UI: **103 React components including 19 chart cards, 10 Pro dashboard templates, Tailwind CSS styling, editable source code**. The launch hook ("stop ai slop in your UI") is a counter-position to the flood of samey LLM-generated dashboards; the endorsement that surfaced it calls it the most advanced dashboard UI the author has seen.

## Why it matters

- Reference bookmark for any dashboard-heavy frontend work — the chart-card component set (19 variants) is the relevant part for trading/perf dashboards, and "editable source" means components are meant to be forked, not just consumed.
- The bookmark ratio on the endorsement (1,908 saves vs 1,025 likes) is the saved-as-tool signal — people are filing this for their next build, same reflex as a recipe.

**Skepticism gates:** vendor page, marketing copy; pricing/license not verified; breadth (103 components) says nothing about depth — would need a hands-on pass before adopting anywhere. No action filed; reference only.
